'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jared LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Republic At War / Aggressive Negotiations]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
